detached_structure.evidence: A small separate gabled roof sits to the southwest of the central house, and a second roof is visible just south near the driveway end, but it is unclear whether either belongs to the central lot.

signals.notes: The central dark-gray-roofed house is partly shaded by mature trees, and an asphalt driveway runs along its east side to the street; the roof looks uniformly dark with some shadow, so its condition is hard to judge.
